summary: The Corporate Energy Buyers Association answers in support of the abeyance motions of PJM, the Indicated PJM Transmission Owners and Silver Run, saying 90 days allows stakeholder feedback before mid-November filings.
ask: Grant the three abeyance motions in an expedited manner.

points.point: CEBA supports a 90-day abeyance because it lets stakeholders work with PJM rather than shift debate to the Commission docket.
points.quote: Granting the requested abeyance will promote administrative efficiencies by allowing time for PJM and stakeholders—including CEBA and its members—to work collaboratively

points.point: CEBA says 90 days would not materially impede FERC's goals and supports commercial viability and legal durability of the mid-November filings.
points.quote: a 90-day extension would not materially impede the Commission’s objectives for advancing reforms quickly

throughLine.text: Answer supporting the abeyance of the E-7 show cause deadline to November 16, 2026; FERC cited it in granting the motions on August 14.
